description: This file defines a mock class for the IVssDatabase interface using the Turtle mock framework. It contains mock method declarations to simulate the behavior of the database for unit testing purposes.

classes.name: IVssDatabaseMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IVssDatabase interface for unit testing, providing mocked methods for database operations.

methods.name: initJsonTree
methods.description: Mocks the initialization of a JSON tree within the database.

methods.name: updateJsonTree
methods.description: Mocks the updating of the JSON tree with data.

methods.name: updateMetaData
methods.description: Mocks updating metadata in the database.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Mocks retrieving metadata from the database.

methods.name: pathExists
methods.description: Checks for the existence of a path.

methods.name: pathIsWritable
methods.description: Checks if the path is writable.

methods.name: pathIsReadable
methods.description: Checks if the path is readable.

methods.name: pathIsAttributable
methods.description: Checks if the path has attribute capabilities.

methods.name: getDatatypeForPath
methods.description: Retrieves the data type for a given path.
